events.title: Leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer a surprise 3–2 home defeat by 더비 카운티.
리버풀's title bid takes a surprise setback when they lose 2–1 at home to relegation battlers 코번트리 시티.
코번트리 시티's survival battle continues with another win over a much stronger opposition – this time 첼시, who find themselves on the receiving end of a 3–1 defeat at Highfield Road .
레스터 시티 beat 미들즈브러 1–0 in the League Cup final replay at Hillsborough thanks to a Steve Claridge goal.

맨체스터 유나이티드 take a huge step towards title glory with a 3–1 away win over their main rivals 리버풀, in which defender 게리 팰리스터 scores twice. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 keep their title challenge alive with a 3–1 home win over 더비 카운티, but 아스널 do themselves no favours as they can only manage a 1–1 draw at home to 블랙번 로버스. 사우샘프턴 and 코번트리 시티 draw 2–2 in a relegation crunch game at The Dell .
첼시 agree a £2.25million fee with 안더레흐트 for 19-year-old Nigerian defender Celestine Babayaro .
미들즈브러 reach their first-ever FA Cup final thanks to a 2–0 win in the semi-final replay against Division Two side 체스터필드 .
In the last ever game at Burnden Park , Division One champions 볼턴 원더러스 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 4–1.
반즐리 are promoted to the Premier League for the first time after defeating 브래드퍼드 시티 2–0 at Oakwell .

맨체스터 유나이티드 look assured of their fourth league title in five seasons, as they finish April top of the league by a five-point margin over 아스널 and 리버풀 – and with a game in hand. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's challenge is all but over, while 애스턴 빌라's hopes are now completely dead, and the midlanders are now facing a threat of being pipped to even a UEFA Cup place – by 셰필드 웬즈데이. The relegation battle is still wide open, with 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 미들즈브러 and 노팅엄 포리스트 occupying the bottom three, and several other teams also fighting to avoid the drop. In Division One, 볼턴 원더러스 are established as champions with 97 points and 98 goals – 17 points ahead of their nearest rivals 반즐리. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 입스위치 타운, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 크리스털 팰리스 will contest the playoffs.
Striker Boudewijn Zenden from PSV 에인트호번 plays his first international match for the Netherlands national football team , when Holland defeats San Marino 6–0 in Serravalle .
